title: Ticket: VPN connection drops every few minutes
text: A remote employee reports that the corporate VPN client disconnects every five to ten minutes while working from home. The user has Windows 11 and uses a home Wi-Fi network. The support agent checked the VPN logs and found repeated authentication timeouts. Resolution: update the VPN client to the latest version, switch the tunnel protocol to UDP, and ask the user to restart the router. The ticket was closed after the connection stayed stable for 48 hours.

title: Ticket: Laptop battery drains quickly after update
text: After the latest operating system update, a sales manager reports that the laptop battery lasts only two hours instead of eight. Support reviewed the power settings and detected a background sync process consuming high CPU. Resolution: disable the unnecessary sync service, update the graphics driver, and recalibrate the battery. If the problem persists, the laptop must be sent for hardware inspection and a replacement battery request must be submitted.

title: Ticket: Cannot access shared drive after password change
text: A finance analyst cannot open the shared network drive after changing the account password. The cached credentials on the workstation were outdated and the drive mapping kept using the old password. Resolution: remove the saved credentials from the credential manager, remap the network drive, and sign in again. The analyst was reminded that a password change should be followed by a full sign-out and sign-in.

title: Ticket: Email attachments blocked by mail filter
text: A project coordinator reports that PDF attachments sent to an external client are blocked by the email security filter. The filter flagged the files because they contained embedded scripts. Support reviewed the files, confirmed they were safe, and exported them again as flattened PDFs. A request was also created to review the attachment filtering rules for external recipients.

title: Ticket: Printer offline on second floor
text: Several employees on the second floor cannot print because the shared printer appears offline. The technician found that the printer had received a new IP address from the DHCP server and the print queue was pointing to the old address. Resolution: assign a static IP address, update the printer port on the print server, and test printing from three workstations.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with prior approval from their direct manager. Remote workers must be available during core hours, use the company VPN to access internal systems, and keep their equipment protected with approved security software. The company provides a laptop and a headset, but employees are responsible for their own internet connection. Managers review the arrangement every six months.

title: Vacation and Paid Time Off Policy
text: Full-time employees accrue paid vacation days according to their years of service. Requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance and approved by the direct manager. Unused days may be carried over for one year only. During peak business periods such as year-end closing, vacation requests may be limited to protect operations.

title: Employee Onboarding Procedure
text: During the first week, new employees receive their laptop, accounts, and building access card. HR schedules a welcome session, and the direct manager assigns a mentor for the first ninety days. New hires must complete mandatory training on information security, code of conduct, and workplace safety before accessing confidential systems. A feedback survey is sent at the end of the first month.

title: Performance Review Guidelines
text: Performance reviews take place twice a year. Employees complete a self-assessment, and managers evaluate results against agreed goals, teamwork, and professional development. Feedback must be specific, documented, and delivered in a one-to-one meeting. Employees with low ratings receive an improvement plan with clear objectives and monthly follow-up sessions. Outstanding performance may be considered for promotion or a bonus.

title: Training and Professional Development Policy
text: The company offers an annual training budget for each employee. Courses, certifications, and conferences must be related to the employee role and approved by the manager before enrollment. After completing a course, the employee shares what they learned in a short internal presentation or a documented summary. Mandatory trainings, such as security awareness, are not charged to the personal budget.

title: Minutes: Q3 Sales Review Meeting
text: Attendees: sales director, regional managers, and the finance analyst. The team reviewed third-quarter results and noted that revenue grew 8 percent compared with the previous quarter, driven by enterprise customers. Mid-size accounts declined because of longer negotiation cycles. Actions: prepare a discount strategy for mid-size accounts, update the sales forecast, and present a revised pipeline next month.

title: Minutes: IT Infrastructure Planning
text: The IT team discussed the migration of internal servers to the cloud. The main risks identified were downtime during the migration, data transfer costs, and user training. The group agreed to start with non-critical applications and to run a pilot with the VPN and shared file services. Actions: define the migration schedule, estimate cloud costs, and review security requirements with the compliance team.

title: Minutes: Product Roadmap Workshop
text: Product managers and engineers met to prioritize features for the next release. Customers have asked for better reporting dashboards, mobile access, and faster search. The team ranked the features by customer impact and development effort. Decisions: reporting dashboards will be delivered first, mobile access moves to the following quarter, and search improvements will be evaluated with a small prototype.

title: Minutes: Customer Support Weekly Sync
text: Support leads reviewed ticket volume, which increased 15 percent after the latest software release. The most common issues were login errors, slow loading of reports, and confusion about the new billing page. The team agreed to publish new FAQ articles, improve the knowledge base search, and train agents on the updated billing process. Average first response time must stay under two hours.

title: Minutes: Information Security Committee
text: The committee reviewed the results of the last phishing simulation, where 12 percent of employees clicked on the simulated link. Participants agreed to reinforce security awareness training, enforce multi-factor authentication for all remote access, and update the incident reporting procedure. The compliance officer will present an audit calendar for the next semester.

title: FAQ: How do I connect to the company VPN?
text: To connect to the company VPN, install the approved VPN client from the software portal, sign in with your corporate username and password, and approve the multi-factor authentication request on your phone. If the connection fails, check your internet connection, update the client, and restart the device. Contact the IT service desk if the problem continues.

title: FAQ: How can I reset my password?
text: You can reset your password from the self-service portal by selecting the forgot password option and verifying your identity with multi-factor authentication. Passwords must have at least twelve characters and include letters, numbers, and symbols. After a reset, sign out of all devices and sign in again. If you are locked out, contact the IT service desk.

title: FAQ: How do I request vacation days?
text: Submit a vacation request in the HR portal at least two weeks before your planned absence. Select the dates, add a short comment, and send the request to your direct manager for approval. You will receive an email with the decision. You can check your remaining vacation balance in the same portal at any time.

title: FAQ: How do I submit an expense report?
text: Expense reports must be submitted in the finance portal within thirty days of the purchase. Attach every receipt, select the cost center, and describe the business purpose. Travel, meals, and client entertainment have different limits. Reports are reviewed by the manager and then by finance, and approved amounts are reimbursed in the next payroll cycle.

title: FAQ: How do I report a technical problem?
text: Open a ticket in the IT service desk portal or send an email to the support mailbox. Include a clear description of the problem, screenshots, the device you use, and the time it started. Tickets are prioritized by business impact. Urgent issues, such as a system outage, should also be reported by phone to the support hotline.

title: Information Security Policy
text: All employees must protect company information from unauthorized access, loss, and disclosure. Confidential data must be stored only on approved systems and never shared through personal email or messaging apps. Devices must have encryption, antivirus software, and automatic screen lock enabled. Any suspected security incident must be reported immediately to the security team.

title: Password and Access Control Standard
text: Access to systems is granted according to the principle of least privilege. Passwords must have a minimum length of twelve characters and must be changed when a compromise is suspected. Multi-factor authentication is required for email, VPN, and administrative accounts. Access rights are reviewed every quarter, and accounts of former employees are disabled on their last working day.

title: Remote Access and VPN Security Requirements
text: Employees who access internal systems from outside the office must use the company VPN with multi-factor authentication. Personal devices may only be used if they are registered and meet the minimum security configuration. Public Wi-Fi networks should be avoided unless the VPN is active. Remote sessions are logged, and unusual access patterns are investigated by the security team.

title: Data Privacy and Retention Policy
text: Personal data of customers and employees must be collected only for legitimate business purposes and kept for the minimum necessary time. Access to personal data is limited to authorized staff. Documents containing personal data must be stored in approved repositories and deleted after the retention period expires. Privacy incidents must be reported within 24 hours to the compliance officer.

title: Incident Response Procedure
text: When a security incident is detected, the reporter must notify the security team immediately. The team classifies the incident by severity, contains the affected systems, preserves evidence, and starts the investigation. Affected users are informed, and a root cause analysis is documented after the incident is closed. Lessons learned are shared with IT, compliance, and management to improve future response.

title: Case: Customer cannot log in to the web portal
text: A customer reports that the web portal rejects valid credentials after the latest software release. The support agent verified the account status, cleared the browser cache, and reset the password. The issue persisted for users with older browsers, so the case was escalated to engineering. A fix was deployed and the customer received a confirmation email.

title: Case: Duplicate charge on monthly invoice
text: A customer noticed two identical charges on the monthly invoice. The billing team reviewed the payment gateway records and confirmed that the second charge was caused by a retry after a temporary timeout. A refund was approved and processed within five business days. The customer was informed and offered a credit as a goodwill gesture.

title: Case: Reports load slowly in the dashboard
text: A business customer reports that the sales reports in the dashboard take more than one minute to load. Support collected the report parameters and found that the date range covered three years of data. The agent recommended using smaller date ranges and scheduled exports. Engineering opened an improvement request to optimize the report queries.

title: Case: Request to change subscription plan
text: A customer wants to upgrade from the basic plan to the premium plan in the middle of the billing period. The agent explained that the new price is prorated and that additional features, such as advanced reporting and priority support, are activated immediately. The upgrade was processed and the customer received an updated invoice.

title: Case: Data export request from customer
text: A customer asked for a full export of their account data to migrate to another system. Support verified the identity of the account owner, following the data privacy procedure, and generated the export in CSV format. The file was shared through a secure link that expires after seven days. The request was logged for compliance purposes.
